messages:
alex: heads-up: onboarding run for hf model 'gpt-mini-3b-quant' failed during convert. looks like safetensors shard ordering got shuffled and weight keys were effectively renamed, tokenizer special token ids shifted after quantization. reproducible on my laptop and CI. :bug:

maria: can you paste the load errors + a quick list of shards that failed?

alex: paste of the failing bits:
```
ERROR: LoaderError: missing key 'transformer.h.5.mlp.fc_out.weight'
During safetensors load: shard 0003.safetensors -> 403 when downloading (hub auth fallback)
Shard manifest order: [0000,0002,0001,0003]  <-- repo listing returned this order
Expected lexicographic: [0000,0001,0002,0003]
```

jordan: CI ran the evals with the converted artifact and metrics are trash: ppl 12.3 -> 47.1, top-1 acc down 14%. Also chat templates ended up with <|pad|> id shifted which breaks decode postproc. :eyes:

ci-bot: convertbot-e2e #342 failed on checkpoint load and downstream eval. See: CI job https://ci.internal/runs/342 (artifact: convert-2240001234) :warning:

sam: notes from quick triage — two separate issues colliding: (1) hub listing order is non-deterministic in this repo because author pushed shards in parallel; (2) convert tool assumes file iteration order -> constructs weight-key map in-first-seen order. When quant step renames keys (per quant spec) and reassigns prefixes, mapping becomes inconsistent. Need deterministic shard-sorting and key canonicalization.

ben: workaround until we patch: run `convert --shard-sort=manifest_sha256 --pin-revision=<commit>` or use `CONVERT_STRICT_ORDER=0 CONVERT_REMAP_KEYS=1` env to force remap and avoid index-based assignment. also re-run tokenizer build with `--preserve-special-token-ids`.

alex: tried ben's env flags, it loads but eval still shows small regressions (ppl 12.3 -> 13.9). so remap helps but not perfect — quant scale mapping still slightly off.

maria: plan: i will open a convertbot PR to 1) sort shards by the safetensors metadata `blob_id`/sha256 (not filename), 2) build canonical weight-key table before any quant rename step, 3) add a fallback to re-download missing shard with auth retry and more verbose errors. will add an integration test that shuffles shard list randomly and asserts deterministic load.

jordan: please also add an eval regression test that runs a tiny prompt suite and checks ppl within 2% of baseline. we had a regression slip-through before.

alex: adding: observed a specific quant corner-case — quantizer emits `lm_head.weight` with dtype int8 and the loader casts to float32 but uses a stale scale vector because keys matched wrong prefix; that's why ppl not fully recovered. patch needs to ensure scales are attached to canonical key names.

maria: filing PR now, will ping for review. linking initial diff in thread when ready. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: created issue #789: "convertbot: deterministic shard ordering + canonical key mapping" and attached failing CI logs.

sam: FYI — we might want to add a convertbot flag `--verify-tokenizer` to compare special token ids before/after and warn on mismatch. low-hanging safety check.

ben: +1 on verification flags. also add an e2e smoke that runs quantize -> load -> small decode -> compare tokens. saves time.

alex: great. thanks all, i'll re-run the quant experiments once the PR lands and report back with fresh eval numbers. :thumbsup:
